subject: [hw] V03→IV: link the vendor set needs the data shims; loader source list and unresolved convention
body:
Integration notes for n2vhost (loader is implemented and host-tested; files gpu/hwcodec/loader/n2elf.c + loader/n2elf_reloc.c, both required):
1. Build list: n2elf.c, n2elf_reloc.c, then include/n2elf.h. n2elf.c has a private bridge to n2elf_reloc.c (n2elf_rctx_*), so both files are needed; do not copy one without the other.
2. n2elf_link() fails on an unresolved *data* import by design. The vendor set imports exactly two OBJECT symbols: __stack_chk_guard (4 bytes) and stderr (4 bytes). Register n2shim_data_all (V34) before link, or a local {name,size,init} table with those two. Without it, link returns -1 with "<soname>: unresolved data import __stack_chk_guard".
3. Unresolved *functions* are bound to n2a32_hostcall_register(NULL, name) slots (one per unique name). After a run stops with N2A32_STOP_NOIMPORT, n2a32_hostcall_name(c->stop_addr) gives the exact import; the vendor set has 146 such names (149 unique imports minus the two data symbols and __aeabi_unwind_cpp_pr0, which has no dynamic relocation). Register the real shim tables before link to reduce this number; adding shims after link does not rebind already-written GOT/PLT slots.
4. n2elf_load() takes the soname that DT_NEEDED entries use, e.g. "libvcodecdrv.so"; the load order is the lookup order (first definition wins), so load vpud first as you planned. NEEDED entries whose soname is not loaded are ignored (no error), which lets partial sets link.
5. n2elf_run_init(s, c) needs c->r[13] (sp) set as for n2a32_call; it runs PREINIT/INIT/INIT_ARRAY in dependency order once per object and returns -1 if the guest stops. It uses n2a32_call, so it needs V02 core ready.
6. Host-verified today: 5 vendor objects load and link with 0 errors, 3120 relocations applied == llvm-readelf, 149 unique imports, 146 unresolved slots; small ARM .so fixtures with plain REL, Android packed, Android packed+RELR and RELR, Thumb, weak symbols, cross-object imports, init arrays, ET_EXEC/type-error/malformed-APS2/unresolved-data negatives. Command: bash gpu/hwcodec/loader/test_v03/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V03 PASS 9509/9509. Ask me for any loader-side change; I will keep the interface stable.
